spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode B: Control Room Grid for Dashboards, Mode A for Landing)
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-aligned for stats and data, optical alignment for icons.

surface_strategies.cards: Tactical Minimalism: bg-[#0F1623] border border-white/10 shadow-none. Hover: border-[#CCFF00]/50
surface_strategies.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky headers and blurred premium overlays. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10
surface_strategies.locked_premium: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050A0F]/80 absolute inset-0 z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center border border-white/5
surface_strategies.buttons: bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-black uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors rounded-none px-8 py-4

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Duotone or Bold weight for tactical feel

hero_background.description: Dramatic night match stadium lights, used for the main landing hero section with bg-black/50 overlay.

feature_pitch.description: Football resting on the pitch under floodlights. Good for 'How it Works' or 'Upload Video' section backgrounds.

scout_portrait.description: Black and white image of a focused football coach. Use in the 'Scout View' section to add authority.

player_action.description: Player kicking ball under stadium lights. Use for the 'Sample Premium Report' background or feature cards.

components_strategy.charts: Recharts for spider/radar charts to show 1-10 scores (Technical, Tactical, Physical, Mentality)
components_strategy.forms: Shadcn UI, highly customized. Square corners, 1px borders, focus:border-[#CCFF00] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#CCFF00]
components_strategy.upload_zone: Dashed border border-white/20 hover:border-[#CCFF00] bg-[#0F1623] transition-colors p-12 text-center flex flex-col items-center gap-4
components_strategy.score_badges: High contrast text on Volt Green background for high scores, Warning Yellow for mid, Red for low.
components_strategy.premium_blur: A visual blur effect over dummy data for the free preview, with a prominent 'Unlock Full Report' button.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with border color shifting to Volt Green.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion for smooth staggered entrances of dashboard widgets.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling mandatory for landing page to feel premium and heavy.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure white text on deep navy meets WCAG AAA.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-video-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion recharts @studio-freight/react-lenis clsx tailwind-merge
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page layouts to achieve asymmetry and heavy overlapping.
Implement Shadcn for forms, modals, and the user/admin dashboards.
Ensure the hero image has a max bg-black/50 overlay. Do not hide the image completely.
Implement the 'Locked Premium' effect using CSS backdrop-blur and a pseudo-element overlay to tease content.
Avoid generic border-radius. Use rounded-none to maintain the 'Tactical/Pro' aesthetic.
All navigation elements must be visible on desktop, no hiding behind hamburger menus.
Admin dashboard should utilize pure screen estate, dense data tables, and minimal padding for high-density scanability.
In Tailwind config, set colors: { volt: '#CCFF00', deepnavy: '#050A0F', surface: '#0F1623' } and fonts: { barlow: ['Barlow Condensed', 'sans-serif'], dm: ['DM Sans', 'sans-serif'] }.
